original_prompt:
Fresh high-resolution photorealistic character-library full-body studio photograph, portrait 2:3. Generate anew from these references, not a pixel edit.
REFERENCE ROLES: Image1 is the exact identity/face/hair anchor. Image2 supplies ONLY the outfit. Image3 (black halter and mini skirt) is the APPROVED BODY PROPORTION MASTER, overriding image2's body or pose. Reproduce image3's long-legged anatomy and compact torso, with this character's own face and clothes.
IDENTITY: The exact woman in the original face and fullbody references, same facial structure, eyes, nose, mouth, complexion and makeup; Honey ash blonde hair in loose side braid over viewer-right shoulder, preserve original braid.
OUTFIT: Ivory cropped long sleeve jacket with small evenly spaced black polka dots, short stand collar and curved open lower fronts; fine white lace underlayer at torso and cuffs. White high-waisted pleated below-knee skirt with pale blue narrow belt and a small polka underskirt edge. White delicate lace tights, pale blue gingham pointed low heel pumps. No handbag.
CRITICAL CORRECTION: earlier attempts had too-long torso, low crotch and short legs. Clearly lengthen BOTH thighs and calves relative to torso. Anatomical crotch at about 49% of crown-to-floor height, natural waist about 38%, knee about 70%; long legs occupy just over half total height. Approx 7.5–8 heads, normal head and shoulder size; never a tiny head or stretched neck. Establish tall long-legged skeletal proportions FIRST, then fit the outfit onto them. A high waist alone or extra skirt length is not enough. Jacket/cardigan torso must not get elongated. Keep clothing construction and appropriate hem landmarks.
POSE: one woman directly facing camera, straight centered head, horizontal eyes, level shoulders and pelvis, torso frontal, straight relaxed legs, parallel feet same depth, arms hanging naturally with empty hands. No tilt, no hip cock, no crossed legs. Entire hair and soles visible with small white margins.
Clean white seamless background, soft even neutral studio illumination, subtle grounding shadow. Native crisp fine facial features, hair strands, fabric and footwear. No bag, handheld prop, head ornament, text, watermark. Preserve identity and hairstyle of image1 exactly. Output one full-body photograph only.
